summary: The PR introduces a property method for `Derivative` to set its `kind`, but it lacks comprehensive tests and documentation.

issues.description: The PR does not include any tests to verify the correctness of the new `kind` property for `Derivative`. This increases the risk of introducing regressions or bugs.
The PR does not update the documentation to reflect the new `kind` property for `Derivative`. This makes it difficult for users to understand how to use this feature.
